subject.title: fix(polls): add default maximum poll option count

question: Should OpenClaw silently truncate Matrix polls over 20 options at the builder boundary, rather than reject the send or retain passthrough behavior?
rationale: The patch intentionally changes what senders receive for oversized input: it preserves delivery but removes poll choices, and the available discussion contains no maintainer-confirmed interoperability policy.

options.title: Keep builder truncation
options.body: Retain the Matrix-local 20-answer truncation and require normal-send-route proof that the resulting event is valid and consistently capped.

options.title: Reject oversized polls
options.body: Use an explicit sender-visible validation error instead of silently removing answer choices.

options.title: Retain passthrough
options.body: Drop the cap until a maintainer-approved Matrix interoperability policy is established.

recommendation.title: Keep builder truncation
recommendation.body: Retain the Matrix-local 20-answer truncation and require normal-send-route proof that the resulting event is valid and consistently capped.

likelyOwner.reason: Explicitly included in the Matrix-poll review discussion and is the best available routing candidate from the supplied evidence.
